_schema.REALM_NAME: string (required) - Azure realm used for the fresh catalog login
_schema.PROCESS_NAME: string (required) - Planning Space process opened before validating links
_schema.GRAVITEE: object (required for Gravitee runs) - REALM_NAME / REALM_KEY overrides merged by applyGatewayOverrides
_schema.quickLinks: array (required) - { name, env, pageTitle }: link label, URL fragment expected after navigation, page title to validate
